taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station Market-road, Bori Metropolis. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 104 | 2.86 | 2.86
2 | 186 | 2.38 | 5.24
3 | 266 | 24.7 | 29.9
4 | 327 | 24.6 | 54.6
5 | 219 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as AAK-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station Market-road, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Note: Market-road, Bori Metropolis**

The 5-layer geoelectric succession at Market-road is as follows:
- **Layer 1:** 104 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, thickness 2.86 m (base: 2.86 m)
- **Layer 2:** 186 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, thickness 2.38 m (base: 5.24 m)
- **Layer 3:** 266 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, thickness 24.7 m (base: 29.9 m)
- **Layer 4:** 327 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, thickness 24.6 m (base: 54.6 m)
- **Layer 5:** 219 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$ (sub-stratum)

Resistivity values increase through the first four layers ($104 < 186 < 266 < 327\ \Omega\cdot\text{m}$) and decrease in the fifth layer ($327 > 219\ \Omega\cdot\text{m}$). Evaluating the consecutive layer triplets gives segments A (1-2-3), A (2-3-4), and K (3-4-5). This confirms the on-file classification of the sounding as an **AAK-type** curve.

{"curve_type_stated": "AAK", "label_issue_flagged": false}
